name: openssl
description: OpenSSL is an open source project that provides a robust, commercial-grade, and full-featured toolkit for the Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) protocols. It is also a general-purpose cryptography library. Why an overlay exists: the pinned baseline builds Windows arm64 with the aarch64 assembly enabled (VC-WIN64-CLANGASM-ARM); Node.js builds the same library for the same platform without it, and this repository's arm64 leg crashes in 248 silent TLS cases with the assembly build where the official Node.js binary - the no-asm build - crashes in none (issue #22). The overlay therefore uses VC-WIN64-ARM plus no-asm on Windows arm64, which is Node.js's own configuration, and leaves every other platform, architecture and linkage byte-identical to the baseline. port-version 1 records that this is the baseline's build with one platform's configuration changed, not a newer upstream release.
